# Clavis Encrypt 3.11.2

## 🛠️ Fixed: originals are now overwritten in place

- When Clavis deletes an original after encrypting (and when it cleans up temporary copies), it overwrites the file with random data first. Earlier versions wrote that random data to a new place on the disk, so on a hard disk the old contents could stay behind until something else reused the space. Clavis now overwrites the file's own contents, then deletes it.
- This is still best effort: on SSDs, USB sticks and memory cards, and where backups, File History or cloud version history keep copies, earlier versions of a file can survive. Encrypting a file is what protects it.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
